sara_support: FYI incoming ticket from ACME.DE — they were charged 19% VAT on invoice INV-2026-0045 despite providing a German VAT ID (DE123456789). Customer says it's a B2B purchase and expects 0% intra-EU VAT.

jules_billing: can you paste the invoice lines and any raw metadata we sent to tax/VIES?

sara_support: pasted the important bits below (copied from billing UI):
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0045
Account: acct_1234
Subtotal: 1000.00 EUR
VAT (19%): 190.00 EUR
Total: 1190.00 EUR
Metadata: {"vat_id":"DE123456789 " , "company_name":"ACME.DE GmbH"}
```

billing-bot: invoice INV-2026-0045 created (stripe_inv_1JXx... ) by charge ch_1JXx... at 2027-04-12T10:02:30Z

mira_tax: quick check of the tax logs — our VIES lookup for DE123456789 returned invalid at time of purchase. Log snippet: `vies_check({"vat_id":"DE123456789 "}) -> {valid:false, error:"FORMAT_ERROR"}`. Looks like trailing whitespace caused the validator to fail.

michael_finance: Oof. Our VAT flow defaults to treating as B2C when VIES fails, hence the 19% line. We need a remediation plan for the customer + a code fix.

jules_billing: Suggested immediate steps: 1) Issue credit note for 190.00 EUR, 2) Reissue invoice with 0% VAT and add note referencing original INV-2026-0045, 3) Patch ingestion to trim vat_id before validation and re-run VIES.

mira_tax: agreed. Also add a retry if VIES returns FORMAT_ERROR — attempt a normalized VAT string (trim, uppercase, remove non-alphanum) before final failover. We should also log original and normalized values for auditing.

sara_support: I'll draft the customer message: "We identified the issue — VAT ID had a trailing space, which caused automated validation to fail and the system to apply domestic VAT. We'll issue a full credit and reissue a 0% invoice today; refund timelines below."

michael_finance: I'll create the credit + replacement invoice now. Credit note CN-2026-0045 for 190.00 EUR will be posted and linked to INV-2026-0045. Expect refund to the original payment method in 5-7 business days. We'll also attach the corrected invoice INV-2026-0045-R.

jules_billing: ops ticket created OPS-4567 to ship the trim+normalize patch in the billing ingestion pipeline. I'll add unit tests for VAT input cleaning and an e2e test that simulates a trailing-space VAT.

ops-bot: OPS-4567 created by jules_billing assigned to eng-infra. ETA sprint+1.

mira_tax: one more note — for manual approvals (rare), if VIES is down we should surface a "manual VAT review required" flag to finance instead of auto-applying domestic VAT. I'll open a small RFC for that.

michael_finance: done on the refund action, posting reference numbers below for bookkeeping:
- Credit note: CN-2026-0045 (190.00 EUR)
- Replacement invoice: INV-2026-0045-R (Subtotal 1000.00 EUR, VAT 0.00 EUR, Total 1000.00 EUR)
- Refund transaction: rfn_1JYy... (pending)

sara_support: I'll notify the customer with the above refs and timeline. Proposed message: "Thanks — we've issued a credit and a corrected invoice. You should see the refund 5-7 business days. We're also fixing our validation pipeline to prevent this in future. Apologies for the inconvenience." :pray:

mira_tax: small follow-up for eng: there are ~12 events in the last 90 days where VIES returned FORMAT_ERROR — I'll attach an audit list to OPS-4567. Could be some customers copy-pasting spaces or formatting from CRMs.

jules_billing: putting the remediation checklist in OPS-4567: trim vat_id, normalize (uppercase, remove punctuation), retry VIES once, if still fail then surface manual review. Add alert if FORMAT_ERROR ratio > 0.5% of lookups in 24h.

michael_finance: Customer-facing follow-up scheduled at 10:30 UTC. Finance will post credit/invoice and cc support.

sara_support: Customer updated: "Thanks, please confirm when it's done." I'll update when refund shows.
